lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  have hu : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  profile_tactic "v1" in (have key1 := hg (fun x => B x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const))
  profile_tactic "v2" in (have key2 := hg (fun x => (0 : V)) IsTestFunction.zero)
  profile_tactic "v3" in (have key3 := hg (fun x => B x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const))
  profile_tactic "v4" in (have key4 : IsTestFunction (fun x => B x • f x₀) := IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  exact absurd key1 (by simp)
